title: Verbs with and without objects
summary: Переходные и непереходные глаголы: когда дополнение обязательно, когда опускается, глаголы с двумя значениями (open, melt, sink), глаголы без предлога (discuss, marry, enter) и с предлогом, два дополнения (give, explain, suggest) и возвратные местоимения.
ru:
## Переходные и непереходные глаголы
**Переходный** глагол требует дополнения: *She made a mistake.* **Непереходный** обходится без него: *The meeting ended.* В английском границы менее жёсткие, чем в русском, и многие глаголы работают в обоих режимах.
- Дополнение можно **опустить**, если оно ясно из контекста: **eat, read, write, drive, cook, sing, win, pay, study, understand, drink**. *Have you eaten?* / *He doesn't drink.* (алкоголь)
- Дополнение **обязательно**: **bring, put, make, take, tell, find, contain, like, love, need, want, enjoy**. ~~I enjoyed.~~ → I enjoyed **it** / I enjoyed **myself**. ~~Please put there.~~ → Please put **it** there.

## Один глагол, два режима
Многие глаголы могут быть и переходными («делать что-то с чем-то»), и непереходными («случаться»): **open, close, start, begin, end, change, break, melt, sink, burn, boil, stop, move, grow, run, ring**.
> She **opened** the door. / The door **opened**. — Она открыла дверь. / Дверь открылась.
> The sun **melted** the snow. / The snow **melted**. — Солнце растопило снег. / Снег растаял.
> They **sank** the ship. / The ship **sank**.
Смысл может заметно меняться: **run a company** (управлять) и **The company runs well**; **grow tomatoes** и **The tomatoes grew**.

## Переходные глаголы, после которых нет предлога
В русском после многих глаголов стоит предлог или падеж с предлогом, а в английском — прямое дополнение. Типичные источники ошибок продвинутых учеников: **discuss, mention, marry, resemble, approach, enter, reach, answer, attend, join, contact, obey, await, address**.
- ~~We discussed about the budget.~~ → We discussed **the budget**.
- ~~She married with a lawyer.~~ → She married **a lawyer**. (Но пассивно: She **is married to** a lawyer.)
- ~~He entered into the room.~~ → He entered **the room**. (**enter into** — только с абстрактным: enter into an agreement)
- ~~She approached to the desk.~~ → She approached **the desk**.

## Непереходные глаголы с предлогом
Наоборот, эти глаголы всегда требуют предлога: **depend on, rely on, wait for, listen to, look at, belong to, apologise to, complain about, succeed in, consist of, arrive at / in, agree with / to, object to**.
> Everything **depends on** the weather. — **Wait for** me! — He **apologised to** the client **for** the delay.
- ~~I'm waiting you.~~ → I'm waiting **for** you. (Формально: **await** — без предлога: We await your reply.)
- **arrive in** + город/страна, **arrive at** + точка (the station, the meeting).

## Два дополнения
Глаголы **give, send, offer, show, lend, bring, tell, teach, pass** допускают два порядка: give **me** the book / give the book **to me**. С **buy, make, find, get, cook** вместо to используется **for**: buy her a gift / buy a gift **for** her.
Важная группа: **explain, suggest, describe, announce, say, mention, introduce, propose, report** — лицо **только** через to и после прямого дополнения:
- ~~She explained me the problem.~~ → She explained the problem **to me**.
- ~~Tom suggested me a solution.~~ → Tom suggested a solution **to me**.
- ~~Please say me the truth.~~ → Please **tell me** the truth.
С местоимениями короткий порядок обычно с to: *She gave it to me* (чаще, чем *gave me it*).

## Возвратные местоимения
В английском возвратное местоимение нужно там, где субъект и объект совпадают, но **действует иначе, чем русское -ся**:
- **нужно**: enjoy **yourself**, behave **yourself**, help **yourself** (to…), introduce **yourself**, teach **myself**, blame **yourself**, treat **ourselves** (to…).
- **не нужно** там, где русский говорит «-ся»: **wash, shave, dress, relax, concentrate, meet, get up, feel** — ~~I washed myself in the morning~~ → I washed / I got washed; ~~We met ourselves~~ → We met; ~~I feel myself tired~~ → I feel tired. Возвратное местоимение при wash / shave / dress добавляют только для акцента: *He can dress himself now* (самостоятельно).

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Please answer to my question.~~ → Please answer **my question**.
- ~~It depends of the weather.~~ → It depends **on** the weather.
- ~~He listened the music.~~ → He listened **to** the music.
en:
## Transitive and intransitive verbs
A **transitive** verb needs an object: *She made a mistake.* An **intransitive** verb does not: *The meeting ended.* Many verbs can be both.
- The object can be **dropped** when the context is clear: **eat, read, write, drive, cook, sing, win, pay, study, drink**. *Have you eaten?*
- The object is **required** with **bring, put, make, take, tell, find, contain, like, love, need, want, enjoy**. ~~I enjoyed.~~ → I enjoyed **it** / **myself**.

## One verb, two uses
**open, close, start, begin, end, change, break, melt, sink, burn, boil, stop, move, grow, run**:
> She **opened** the door. / The door **opened**.
> The sun **melted** the snow. / The snow **melted**.
Sometimes the meaning shifts: **run a company** / The company **runs** well.

## Transitive verbs without a preposition
Common mistakes for advanced learners: **discuss, mention, marry, resemble, approach, enter, reach, answer, attend, join, contact, obey**.
- ~~We discussed about the budget.~~ → We discussed **the budget**.
- ~~She married with a lawyer.~~ → She married **a lawyer** (she **is married to** a lawyer).
- ~~She approached to the desk.~~ → She approached **the desk**.

## Intransitive verbs with a preposition
**depend on, rely on, wait for, listen to, look at, belong to, apologise to, complain about, succeed in, consist of, arrive at / in, agree with / to**.
- ~~I'm waiting you.~~ → I'm waiting **for** you. (**await** takes no preposition: We await your reply.)

## Two objects
**give, send, offer, show, lend, bring, tell, teach, pass**: give **me** the book / give the book **to me**. With **buy, make, find, get** we use **for**: buy her a gift / buy a gift **for** her.
**explain, suggest, describe, announce, say, mention, introduce, propose, report** allow only the pattern with **to**:
- ~~She explained me the problem.~~ → She explained the problem **to me**.
- ~~Please say me the truth.~~ → Please **tell me** the truth.

## Reflexive pronouns
Use a reflexive when subject and object are the same person, but not like the Russian *-ся*:
- **needed**: enjoy **yourself**, behave **yourself**, help **yourself**, introduce **yourself**, teach **myself**, blame **yourself**.
- **not needed**: wash, shave, dress, relax, concentrate, meet, get up, feel. ~~I feel myself tired.~~ → I feel tired. We add a reflexive to **wash / dress** only for emphasis: *He can dress himself now.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~It depends of the weather.~~ → It depends **on** the weather.
- ~~He listened the music.~~ → He listened **to** the music.
structure:
## Типы глаголов
| Тип | Примеры | Пример предложения |
|---|---|---|
| Только переходные | bring, put, make, tell, contain | She made a decision. |
| Объект часто опускается | eat, read, drive, cook, win, pay | Have you eaten? |
| Оба режима | open, melt, sink, start, break, run | The door opened. / She opened the door. |
| Непереходные + предлог | depend on, wait for, listen to, belong to | It depends on you. |
| Переходные без предлога | discuss, mention, marry, enter, reach, resemble | We discussed the plan. |

## Два дополнения
| Группа | Модель | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| give, send, offer, show, lend | V + person + thing / V + thing + to person | send her a file / send a file to her |
| buy, make, find, get, cook | V + person + thing / V + thing + for person | buy him a coat / buy a coat for him |
| explain, suggest, describe, announce, say, mention | V + thing + **to** person | explain the rule **to** us |

## Возвратные местоимения
| Нужно | Не нужно |
|---|---|
| enjoy / behave / help / introduce / blame yourself | wash, shave, dress, relax, concentrate, meet |
| teach myself, treat ourselves | get up, feel, hurry up |

exercises.title: Предлог после глагола
exercises.example: Everyone is waiting ___ the results. → Everyone is waiting **for** the results.

items.text: She apologised {{to}} the client for the delay.
He explained the procedure {{to}} us in detail.
Our train arrived {{at}} the station ten minutes late.
We arrived {{in}} Lisbon late at night.
They really enjoyed {{themselves}} at the festival.
I taught {{myself}} to play the guitar.
Maria introduced {{herself}} to the new neighbours.
We should treat {{ourselves}} to a holiday this year.
Anna, don't blame {{yourself}}: it wasn't your fault.
He cut {{himself}} while he was shaving.

items.q: We need to discuss ___ before Friday.
The glass ___ when it hit the floor.
She ___ her colleague on the phone.

items.why: **tell** + лицо + информация; say и explain лицо без to не принимают.

items.q: I really enjoyed ___ at the party.
items.why: **enjoy** требует дополнения: возвратное местоимение, если радуется сам субъект.

items.q: He ___ with the manager about the problem.
items.why: **talk with / to** — непереходный; discuss и announce принимают прямое дополнение.

options: Pass to me the salt, please.
Pass me to the salt, please.
items.why: pass + лицо + вещь: **Pass me the salt**.

options: Tom suggested a solution to me.
Tom suggested that I try again.
items.why: **suggest** не допускает порядка «лицо + вещь»; нужно **to me**.

exercises.title: Перефразируйте
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя глагол в скобках.

items.prompt: We talked about the proposal for an hour. (discuss) → We ...
answers: We discussed the proposal for an hour.

items.prompt: She is similar to her father in appearance. (resemble) → She ...
answers: She resembles her father in appearance.

items.prompt: They went into the building through the back door. (enter) → They ...
answers: They entered the building through the back door.

items.prompt: Anna and Boris got married in 2012. (marry) → Anna ...
I gave a book to her. (без to) → I gave ...
I'll send a message to the client. (без to) → I'll send ...
answers: I'll send the client a message.
I will send the client a message.
She explained the problem to me.

items.prompt: He is married with a lawyer.
answers: He is married to a lawyer.
Please tell the truth to me.

items.prompt: Что вы обсуждали с коллегами или друзьями на этой неделе? (discuss)
items.sample: We discussed our holiday plans for the summer.

items.prompt: От чего зависит ваш выбор работы или места жизни? (depend on)
items.sample: My choice of job depends on the salary and the location.

items.prompt: Что вы недавно объяснили или показали другу? (explain / show)
items.sample: I explained the new rules to my friend and showed him the website.

items.prompt: На что вы любите смотреть или что слушать в свободное время? (look at / listen to)
items.sample: I like listening to podcasts and looking at old photographs.

items.prompt: Как вы обычно развлекаетесь на отдыхе? (enjoy yourself)
items.sample: I enjoy myself most when I go hiking in the mountains.

items.prompt: Чему вы научили себя сами? (teach myself)
items.sample: I taught myself to cook by watching videos.
